semantic_cases.name: missing_route_accepts_and_freezes_complete_target_set
semantic_cases.given: one locally authored Realm Event passes admission and one distinct authorized recipient service has no verified route
invariants: canonical Event, complete distinct target set and all outbox intents commit in one transaction
the missing-route target is durable pending_route
submit returns pending_delivery_count 1 and clients derive pending state
submit exposes no target_id or service_id
service_unavailable is not used to roll back the admitted Event

semantic_cases.name: any_target_or_intent_write_failure_rolls_back_everything
semantic_cases.given: a local Event has two distinct authorized target services
semantic_cases.action: fault-inject failure while writing the second target or intent
invariants: no canonical Event row remains
no partial target set or outbox intent remains
retry can commit the exact complete unit once

semantic_cases.name: restart_preserves_pending_route_without_attempt_budget_expiry
semantic_cases.given: one pending_route intent whose frozen authority remains current
semantic_cases.action: exceed the operational alert threshold, evict caches and restart repeatedly
invariants: the same target_id and idempotency key remain durable
the implementation emits an operational alert
TTL, attempt count and dead-letter policy never terminate this Realm fanout obligation

semantic_cases.name: route_recovery_delivers_idempotently
semantic_cases.given: a durable pending_route intent and unchanged exact frozen member delivery authority
semantic_cases.action: install a valid current service route and run the dispatcher
invariants: the dispatcher rechecks authority before network send
the intent advances through pending_delivery to delivered
retries use the original idempotency key and create no second target
delivery status targets contain no pending row, so clients derive count 0 and complete state

semantic_cases.name: authority_loss_cancels_before_send_and_rejoin_does_not_revive
semantic_cases.given: all frozen exact member or delivery-binding witnesses for a pending target have left, been banned or rebound
semantic_cases.action: make a route available, run the dispatcher, then join the same member or service again under a new Event frontier
invariants: no network request is sent after authority loss
the old intent becomes terminal cancelled_authority_lost
a new membership Event or delivery-binding frontier never revives the old intent
only later locally accepted Events may create new targets

semantic_cases.name: one_shared_service_remains_authorized_while_any_frozen_witness_is_current
semantic_cases.given: two frozen joined members map to one distinct recipient service
semantic_cases.action: one member leaves while the other exact witness remains current
invariants: there is one target and one outbox intent for the service
authority is retained because at least one frozen witness still matches
cancellation occurs only after every frozen witness is invalid

semantic_cases.name: authorized_status_read_is_complete_and_topology_redacted
semantic_cases.given: a caller can read the Event but can read only one of two contributing member delivery-bindings
invariants: all targets are returned sorted by unique stable target_id
service_id is present only on targets backed by a delivery-binding visible to the caller
unknown and Event-invisible selectors both return not_found
the read performs no route resolution, retry or state transition

semantic_cases.name: offline_target_does_not_block_later_realm_authorship
semantic_cases.given: one target remains pending_route for a long period while its authority remains current
semantic_cases.action: members author and admit additional Realm Events
invariants: the offline target cannot convert later valid submissions to service_unavailable
each Event freezes its own target authority generation
later successful targets deliver independently
